question: In which of the following countries is the headquarters of International Table Tennis Federation situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Switzerland**__.

__
 
• **The headquarters of the International Table Tennis Federation is situated in Lausanne, Switzerland**.

 
 
• The International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) is the governing body for all national table tennis federations.
 
• The role of the ITTF includes overseeing rules and regulations and seeking technical improvements to the game of table tennis.
 
• The ITTF is responsible for organizing several international competitions, including the World Table Tennis Championships which has been running since 1926.
